annotations.title: Pre-release check for an MCP server

description: For MCP server publishers, before releasing a new version. Give the server name (as listed in the MCP Registry) or its endpoint, the new tools/list result and the new serverInfo.version; with no tools the endpoint is read as it serves now. Returns, against CrawlCheck's last read of that server, what public change logs will record: tools added and removed, descriptions rewritten, input schemas widened, annotations changed (read-only to write and non-destructive to destructive flagged as escalations), whether the version moved, and verdicts such as version_bump_needed or looks_like_rug_pull_risk. Signed. No tool on the checked server is called.

endpoint.description: Remote MCP endpoint URL, e.g. https://mcp.example.com/mcp

server_name.description: Name in the MCP Registry, e.g. io.github.owner/server

tools.description: The new tools/list tools array; omit to read the endpoint live

name: mcp_precheck
title: Pre-release check for an MCP server
